content:
Requirement R13 (output): Communicate UAV Status. Fixed modalities: Screen and Audio-out. Intent: Convey the current status of a UAV to the pilot..

We will design this requirement in three sequential layers, all within THIS conversation: Function first, then Behaviour, then Structure. Conduct the sequence yourself — when a layer is agreed, state its final label clearly and move to the next.
- Functions: propose 2-3 genuinely distinct candidates labeled F-13.1, F-13.2, ... Distinct means each opens a different interaction goal — not the same goal reworded.
- Behaviours: one distinct interaction idea per fixed modality pathway (e.g. one Touch-only, one Keyboard-only), plus a Mixed pathway if it adds real value beyond the two. Labeled Be-13.<F>.1, Be-13.<F>.2, ... using the closed F index.
- Structures: 2-3 distinct sets of concrete HMI elements, labeled S-13.<F>.<Be>.1, ... using the closed F and Be indices.

Start with the Function candidates now (state the intent back first). The designer closes the whole requirement at the end.

**Intent restated:** Convey the current status of a UAV to the pilot as an output-only function, using Screen and Audio-out.

Note: R12 already covers *on-demand* UAV status display (map-selectable docked pane). R13 must open a genuinely different goal, not re-fetch-on-request. The natural distinct role for an output-only R13 is *continuous/pushed awareness* and *state-change signalling* — the system keeping the pilot aware without a query.

**Function candidates:**

**F-13.1 — Sustain continuous UAV status awareness (ambient monitoring).**
Goal: keep an always-available, at-a-glance representation of the controlled UAV's current state (link, mode, health, position) so the pilot maintains a live mental model without querying. Distinct from R12 (which is pull/on-demand): this is persistent push.

**F-13.2 — Signal UAV status *changes/transitions* (event-driven notification).**
Goal: draw pilot attention when the UAV's status changes state (e.g. mode transition, link degrade, health warning, tracking lock acquired/lost). Not the steady value — the *delta*. This is where Audio-out earns its place: acoustic cue on transition.

**F-13.3 — Convey UAV status *degradation/loss* as a safety-graded alert.**
Goal: specifically flag abnormal/critical UAV conditions (link loss, sensor failure, fuel/emergency) with criticality grading. Overlaps R08's notification framework but scoped to UAV-health semantics.

My recommendation: **F-13.1** is the cleanest primary — it's the core "communicate current status" intent and is clearly output-only. F-13.2 and F-13.3 are strong but lean toward *alerting*, which risks re-treading R08 (priority messages) and R02 (multi-channel alert). If you want R13 to be the steady-state awareness layer complementary to R12's on-demand pull, F-13.1 is the pick.

Which function do you want to close on?
R12 already covers constant status refreshing, no?

Correct — let me separate them precisely.

R12 is **on-demand**: pilot selects a UAV on the map, a docked status pane opens, and it shows *live* values (refreshing while open). The trigger is the pilot's query, and the scope is the *selected* UAV's detailed parameters.

So R12 already covers "live values while I'm looking at the pane." That means F-13.1 as I framed it (persistent ambient display) does overlap R12 meaningfully — you're right to flag it.

What's genuinely *not* covered by R12:
- R12 says nothing about **alerting the pilot when status changes while the pane isn't open / isn't being looked at**. R12 is passive-while-displayed; it doesn't push.
- R12 has no **Audio-out** dimension at all — and R13's fixed modalities are Screen *and* Audio-out. A pure re-display function can't justify Audio-out; only a change/event/degradation function can.

So the modality constraint itself pushes R13 away from F-13.1 and toward the event-driven candidates. Revised recommendation:

**F-13.2 — Signal UAV status changes/transitions** as primary. It's the distinct goal (delta, not steady value), it uses Audio-out for the transition cue, and it complements R12 rather than duplicating it: R12 shows the values when you look; R13 tells you *when to look*.

F-13.3 (degradation/loss safety alert) stays available but risks colliding with R08's criticality-tiered strip.

Want to close on **F-13.2**?

**F-13.2 closed** — Signal UAV status changes/transitions (event-driven notification): draw pilot attention on a UAV status *delta* (mode transition, link degrade/restore, health change, tracking lock acquired/lost), output-only via Screen and Audio-out. Complements R12 (values-on-demand) by signalling *when* the state changed.

---

**Behaviour candidates for F-13.2** (fixed modalities: Screen, Audio-out — both output; no input pathway since this is push output):

**Be-13.2.1 — Screen-only visual transition cue.**
On a detected UAV status change, the system renders a visual event marker: the R12 status pane's changed field flashes/highlights + a transition entry appears in a UAV-status notification line (WAD, with HUD summary for critical deltas). Marker persists (latched highlight) until the pilot's attention lands on the pane or it auto-decays after N seconds. No sound. Measurable: change-to-display latency, dwell/decay time.

**Be-13.2.2 — Audio-only transition cue.**
On a status change, the system emits an acoustic signal — a distinct earcon per change-class (link, mode, health, track) and/or a short TTS phrase ("UAV-2 link degraded"). No visual required to *notice* the event. Measurable: change-to-audio latency, per-class distinguishability, phrase intelligibility under cockpit noise.

**Be-13.2.3 — Mixed synchronized cue (adds real value).**
Both channels fire on the same event, synchronized: audio earcon/TTS draws attention off-visual-axis, visual marker on WAD/HUD carries the detail and persists after the sound stops. Criticality-graded: low-severity deltas = visual-only (silent), high-severity (link loss, health critical) = audio + persistent visual. This is the redundancy-complete pathway — pilot catches the event whether looking or not.

The Screen/Audio-out redundancy rule effectively *requires* Be-13.2.3 as the delivered behaviour: neither channel alone satisfies "pilot must be able to receive the status via either modality." Be-13.2.1 and Be-13.2.2 are the single-channel decompositions that 13.2.3 unifies.

Recommendation: **Be-13.2.3**. Flag: this mixed synchronized cue mechanism could be **shared with R02/R08's alert frameworks** — R08 already does criticality-tiered WAD+HUD distribution with multi-channel critical alerts. R13's UAV-status deltas are plausibly *a feed into* that same alert framework rather than a new one. Worth consolidating later.

Which behaviour do you want to close on?

**Be-13.2.3 closed** — Mixed synchronized cue: on a UAV status delta, both channels fire together, criticality-graded (low-severity = silent visual marker; high-severity = audio earcon/TTS + persistent visual on WAD/HUD). Redundancy-complete: pilot catches the event via either modality. Flagged for later consolidation with R02/R08 alert frameworks.

---

**Structure candidates for Be-13.2.3:**

**S-13.2.3.1 — Reuse R08 notification framework as the delivery surface.**
- UAV status deltas feed into R08's **criticality-tiered notification strip** (WAD + HUD) as a new message-class ("UAV-STATUS").
- Change-detection logic sits on the R12 UAV status store; on delta, it emits a tiered event into R08's strip.
- Audio-out: R08's existing redundant critical-alert audio channel fires the earcon/TTS for high-tier deltas.
- Visual persistence + single-acknowledgment clearing inherited from R08.
- **Minimal new structure** — just the change-detector + message-class mapping. Cleanest reuse.

**S-13.2.3.2 — Dedicated UAV-status event layer on the R12 pane + own audio.**
- New **UAV-status event overlay** anchored to the R12 docked status pane: changed field latches a highlight, a scrolling delta-log line sits at the pane footer.
- HUD gets a compact one-line UAV-status summary for high-tier deltas only.
- Dedicated **earcon set + TTS** for UAV deltas, distinct from R08's generic alert tones (per-class: link/mode/health/track).
- Self-contained, tightly coupled to R12; doesn't touch R08. Costs a parallel audio/visual channel that risks conflicting with R08's tones.

**S-13.2.3.3 — Hybrid: R08 strip for attention + R12 pane for detail.**
- High-tier delta → R08 strip entry + R08 audio (attention/acknowledgment).
- Same delta *also* latches the R12 pane's changed-field highlight (detail-in-context).
- Low-tier delta → R12 pane highlight only, silent, no strip.
- One change-detector drives both surfaces; audio owned solely by R08 (no competing tone sets).
- Uses each surface for what it's best at; more integration wiring than 13.2.3.1.

Recommendation: **S-13.2.3.3**. It respects the R12/R08 division already in your requirement set — R08 owns attention-getting + audio (avoids duplicate/competing earcons), R12 owns the live detail view — and routes low-severity deltas silently to the pane so you don't spam the strip. S-13.2.3.1 is the leaner choice if you'd rather not wire deltas into the R12 pane at all and let all deltas live purely in the R08 strip.

Which structure do you want to close on?

**S-13.2.3.3 closed** — Hybrid: single change-detector on the R12 UAV status store drives both surfaces. High-tier deltas → R08 strip entry + R08 audio (attention/acknowledgment) *and* R12 pane changed-field highlight (detail-in-context); low-tier deltas → R12 pane highlight only, silent. Audio owned solely by R08 (no competing tone sets).

---

**R13 complete. Final summary:**

- **F-13.2** — Signal UAV status changes/transitions (event-driven, output-only via Screen + Audio-out); complements R12's on-demand values by signalling *when* state changed.
- **Be-13.2.3** — Mixed synchronized cue, criticality-graded: low-severity silent visual, high-severity audio + persistent visual; redundancy-complete across Screen/Audio-out.
- **S-13.2.3.3** — Hybrid delivery: one delta-detector → R08 tiered strip (WAD+HUD) + audio for high-tier, R12 pane changed-field highlight for detail/low-tier.

**Consolidation flags for later:**
- Audio + attention-getting fully delegated to **R08**'s framework (new UAV-STATUS message-class) — no new audio hardware/channel.
- Detail highlight reuses the **R12** docked status pane.
- R13 introduces essentially one new logical component: the **change-detector** on the R12 status store. Everything else is reuse.

Requirement R13 ready for your close.
